current_hypothesis: A recursive four-dimensional fold tree built from coupled control-translation Hamiltonians may realize a Schlenk-style multiple-folding analogue without reverting to cotangent lifts: use the first symplectic plane to write temporary branch information into the second plane, then read that signal back to collapse the first plane toward each pair midpoint.
stop_reason: Attempt 018 implemented `src/hierarchical_braid_fold_search.py`, a genuinely new recursive coupled `q,p` Hamiltonian family inspired by multiple symplectic folding rather than cotangent lifts or half-space transvections. The construction uses pair-tree stages that write temporary branch information into `(q2,p2)` and then read it back to collapse the `(q1,p1)` direction. The attempt found and fixed a real stage-B sign bug that had made the first version anti-fold; after that fix, the strongest no-return candidate saved in `results/research_loop/attempt_018_manual_best_dense.json` achieved dense best radius `11.746645430549528`, dense worst radius `12.00466423985685`, dense best ratio `0.0005252239970962225`, and dense worst ratio `0.0004815040330731911`. Two ablations were also preserved in `results/research_loop/attempt_018_ablation_notes.md`: a partial-return-stage variant worsened to dense worst radius `12.454715489557286`, and a targeted sharp-readout sweep still preferred the broadest tested target-sign width, with dense worst radius `12.029543054273557`. The emitted `Hamiltonian.py` was then audited directly in `results/research_loop/attempt_018_hamiltonian_audit.json`; the 512-point, 5-seed audit reports radii `11.937526341426917` to `12.160933972735252`, min ratio `0.00045722743136449354`, and batch-5000 call time `0.05906584200056386` seconds. This is strong negative evidence that the temporary auxiliary-plane workspace dominates the radius in this family, so the recursive control-translation braid line remains far from the target.

last_summary.worked: Saved `results/literature/attempt_018_multiple_folding_notes.md` to justify a recursive multiple-folding direction from Schlenk's 2005 titles, despite intermittent Semantic Scholar `429` limits. Implemented `src/hierarchical_braid_fold_search.py`, a new recursive coupled Hamiltonian family built from pairwise level-tree stages: stage A writes a temporary branch signal into `(q2,p2)`, stage B uses that signal to translate `(q1,p1)` back toward each pair midpoint, and the script emits a real root `Hamiltonian.py`. The first implementation exposed a genuine sign bug in stage B; after fixing that, the no-return family improved dramatically and the strongest manual dense rerun saved in `results/research_loop/attempt_018_manual_best_dense.json` achieved best radius `11.746645430549528`, worst radius `12.00466423985685`, best ratio `0.0005252239970962225`, and worst ratio `0.0004815040330731911`. I also saved `results/research_loop/attempt_018_ablation_notes.md` to preserve two important internal checks: the anti-fold sign-bug run and a partial-return-stage ablation. Finally, I audited the emitted `Hamiltonian.py` with `src/hamiltonian_audit.py`, saving `results/research_loop/attempt_018_hamiltonian_audit.json`; the 512-point, 5-seed audit reports radii `11.937526341426917` to `12.160933972735252`, ratios `0.0004924278740676749` down to `0.00045722743136449354`, and batch-5000 call time `0.05906584200056386` seconds.
last_summary.did_not_work: This new family still does not make the proposed solution correct. Even the strongest manually restored candidate in this family only gets the enclosing-ball radius down to about `12`, with direct audited ratios around `4.6e-4` to `4.9e-4`, which is worse than attempt 017 and still orders of magnitude below the required near-full-density regime. The failure mode is structural: the family needs large temporary auxiliary-plane motion to distinguish branches reliably, and that temporary workspace becomes the dominant contributor to the Euclidean radius. A partial-return stage meant to give that workspace back only made the family worse.
last_summary.next_step: Leave recursive control-translation braid folds. The next family should keep genuine four-dimensional coupling but replace temporary plane-to-plane translations by more intrinsically compressive local primitives, such as coupled quadratic squeeze/rotation gates or a direct ellipsoid/polydisk-style folding model that does not spend an entire symplectic plane as a label register.
